import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def bands(I): return [np.array(I[:,0:4]),np.array(I[:,5:9]),np.array(I[:,10:14]),np.array(I[:,15:19])]
# Hypothesis: winner band = band whose COLOR has the largest total count in the whole input grid? Check per demo.
for n in ['1','2','3','4','5']:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    B=bands(I); cnt=[int(b.sum()) for b in B]
    colors=[int(b[b!=0][0]) for b in B]
    # map each output cell to winning band index, then check ranking of cnt among claimants
    ok=True;mism=[]
    for i in range(4):
        for j in range(4):
            cl=[k for k,b in enumerate(B) if b[i,j]!=0]
            if not cl: continue
            w=int(O[i,j]); owner=[k for k in cl if int(B[k][i,j])==w][0]
            pred=max(cl,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
            if pred!=owner: mism.append(((n,i,j),(int(B[pred][i,j]),w)))
    print(n,'density-of-color rule mismatches:',len(mism),mism[:5])
